name: ios-firebase

platform.name: Firebase
platform.why: Firebase/firebase.json declares hosting, functions, Firestore and the Realtime Database

stays.note: serves Firebase/public/ as static files: a landing page, legal pages, the invite page and apple-app-site-association
onCall endpoints and Realtime Database triggers from firebase-functions/v2; one 1st gen auth onDelete trigger (deleteUserData, firebase-functions/v1)

notes: An iOS app (Haptics/, Widgets/, AyoIntentExtension/ and the Swift packages under Packages/) with its backend in Firebase/: Firebase Hosting of static pages and one functions codebase in Firebase/functions/src/index.ts. The functions are firebase-functions/v2 (https.onCall, database.onValue*) except deleteUserData, a 1st gen auth.user().onDelete trigger; all of it stays. No server code matches any rule; the Swift sources use Timer and FileManager on the device, which no rule reads, and Firebase/functions/scripts/backfill-user-conversations-index.js is a one-off maintenance script. There is no process to move, so nothing in the repository runs on Cloud Run beyond what Firebase already deploys.
